scope: Captured seven-sample walks: exact represented-model obstructions and separate numerical arc diagnostics; no PVS, binary64 refinement, C20 equivalence or physical calibration proof

extraction.sampling_scope: Original CSV row order; night elevation<-3, five positional transition bins -3<elevation<8, day elevation>8; no sorting, remainder repair or data cleaning

thresholds.selection: Defaults declared before captured-data evaluation; the values above expose any caller overrides

point_coordinates.mass_scope: Informative only: unit mass is not a shortest_arc_trace? hypothesis

exact_necessary_conditions.scope: Exact rational arithmetic on embedded frozen binary64 point coordinates; not physical data or a Python/PVS refinement proof

uncentered_unit_plane.criterion: maximum unit-direction distance to best uncentered rank-two plane <= plane tolerance + machine floor

monotone_shortest_arc.reason: Inactive steps or failed uncentered plane criterion

metrics.mean_h_comparison_scope: Diagnostic substitution of mean h; not the theorem formula unless its hypotheses hold
metrics.inactive_scope: Raw cutoff-branch values remain defined; inactive samples cannot certify a shortest arc

numerical_diagnostics.scope: Floating-point tolerance diagnostic only; no exact membership or PVS theorem instantiation is certified
